svg.title: Complete Engine API JSON vs SSZ codec benchmark table
svg.desc: Complete benchmark tables comparing JSON and SSZ encoding and decoding for Engine API payloads, payload envelopes, bodies, blobs, and witness responses.
svg.text: Engine API JSON vs SSZ Codec Benchmark
Alloy rpc-types-engine, codec-only, release benchmark, 20 real mainnet blocks from https://ethereum.reth.rs/rpc
JSON and SSZ encode/decode for every row

g.text: Max rows are included in the Markdown table. Avg blob count for envelopes: 3.0 per block.
REST fork containers - serde, average rows
This panel summarizes representative average rows. The Markdown file includes every avg and max row.
V1 uses real blob bytes and EIP-4844 KZG proofs. V2/V3/V4 use real blob bytes or cells with proof-shaped placeholder cell-proof lists.
Wire JSON -> SSZ compares encoded byte sizes. Speedup is JSON time divided by SSZ time for the same value set.
The benchmark is codec-only: no HTTP, JWT, RPC routing, validation, block execution, storage, or consensus interaction.
All fixture parsing and payload construction happens before measured loops.
For the complete max rows and every fork row, use codec-results.md; this SVG includes all benchmark families and the detailed blob/body/witness tables.

svg.text: Generated from: cargo bench --package alloy-rpc-types-engine --bench codec --features ssz
